## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: End-to-end test (tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh) creates a session worktree with 2 sub-PRs in flight; attempts claude-safe cleanup; asserts refusal.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh`.

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given a fixture session worktree at session/test branch
- Given two mock open PRs detected by the 3-tier fallback (use gh CLI mocking via PATH override or a fake gh script): main session\xe2\x86\x92main PR (PR #1001) AND sub-PR sub/feat\xe2\x86\x92session (PR #1002)
- When claude-safe is invoked without --force
- Then exit code is non-zero AND stderr contains BOTH PR URLs AND identifies guard 'open_pr_with_ci'

- When claude-safe is invoked WITH --force
- Then exit code is 0 AND stderr STILL contains BOTH PR URLs (logged before bypass)

The test sets up a real ephemeral git repo (mktemp) for fidelity but mocks gh CLI calls.

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_claude_safe_multiple_sub_prs]`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists and executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh
- [ ] Test covers BOTH no-force refusal AND --force bypass scenarios
  Verify: grep -cE 'force|refuse|bypass' tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh | awk '{exit (\$1>=3?0:1)}'
- [ ] Test mocks gh CLI to return 2 open PRs
  Verify: grep -qE 'mock.*gh|fake.*gh|PATH.*override' tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh
- [ ] After T3, this E2E test passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_claude_safe_multiple_sub_prs\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
